config.baseUrl: Confluence base URL (e.g. `https://confluence.example.com`). When set, internal page links (`ri:page` with a space key) resolve to real `/display/SPACE/Title` URLs instead of offline placeholders.
config.jiraBaseUrl: Jira base URL (e.g. `https://jira.example.com`). Used by `jira` macros that carry no `baseurl` parameter, turning issue keys into real links.
config.localFiles: Resolve attachment links, `ac:image` and relative `` paths against files next to the source document. External resources are never loaded (offline-only).
config.refreshDebounce: Delay in milliseconds before the preview refreshes while typing.
config.outlineVisible: Show the outline sidebar when the preview opens. Can also be toggled from the preview header.
config.enableForHtml: Also offer the preview for plain `.html` files (off by default — the preview targets Confluence storage format).
